scripts.build: npm run build -w @bridge-ui/core && npm run build -w @bridge-ui/vue && npm run build -w @bridge-ui/react
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @bridge-ui/vue & npm run dev -w @bridge-ui/react
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:core && npm run type-check:vue && npm run type-check:react
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bridge-ui/core && npm run test -w @bridge-ui/vue && npm run test -w @bridge-ui/react
scripts.test:run: npm run test:run -w @bridge-ui/core && npm run test:run -w @bridge-ui/vue && npm run test:run -w @bridge-ui/react
scripts.test:cy: npm run test:cy:vue && npm run test:cy:react
scripts.lint: eslint packages/core/src packages/react/src packages/react/docs/examples packages/vue/src packages/vue/docs/examples
scripts.lint:fix: eslint packages/core/src packages/react/src packages/react/docs/examples packages/vue/src packages/vue/docs/examples --fix
